meta.themes: Light and Dark are Meridian with the GitLama brand; the other themes are the same core with each app's accent family. Fonts and radii per brand are listed in the Brands section.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window or screen canvas behind islands. Chrome (sidebar, toolbar, tab strip, mobile app bar) sits straight on it. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: ground-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows, tabs and toolbar buttons that sit on `ground`. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Island surface: lists, readers, editors, inspectors. The default reading surface. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: pane-alt
tokens.usage: Inset areas inside an island: docked editors, table headers, section strips, zebra rows, search wells. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: pane-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows and quiet controls inside an island. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Everything that floats: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs, sheets, the command palette. Always with `shadow-float`. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The desk behind documents: page feeds, image, scan and PDF viewers, print previews. Documents sit on it as paper and islands float over it. Text on it is chrome (a page number, a zoom level) in `ink` or `ink-muted`. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modal dialogs and bottom sheets only, never behind popovers or menus. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `ground`, `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised` and `accent-soft` (at least 5.5:1 in both themes). A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, counts, captions, section headers, idle icons. Reads on `ground`, `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised` and `accent-soft` (at least 4.5:1). A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, placeholders and de-emphasised marks. Never for text a person must read (about 3:1). A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers and separators inside islands, the neutral count badge. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of controls that also carry a label or icon: secondary buttons, the select trigger, keycaps, the switch track. A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Boundary of text fields, checkboxes, radios and switches (at least 3:1 on `pane` and `raised`). A brand may set its own.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and healthy states: completed operations, running processes, synced, added. Text and icons on `pane`, `raised` and `success-bg`.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success toast and banner tint; background of added lines.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and changed-but-unsaved states, thresholds crossed. Text and icons on `pane`, `raised` and `warning-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner and toast tint.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, failed states. Text and icons on `pane`, `raised` and `danger-bg`; the danger button fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner and toast tint; hover fill of a danger-quiet button; background of removed lines.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Work the person has to do that is not a failure: conflicts, pending review, action required. Orange, never red. Text on `pane` and `attention-bg`.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Text on an `attention` fill, such as the attention count badge.

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: Attention banner tint and background of regions that need a decision.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 1 (blue): chart series, avatars, labels, graph lanes. Always paired with a name or shape. At least 4:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 2 (teal). At least 4:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 3 (amber). At least 4:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 4 (orange). At least 3:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 5 (rose). At least 4:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 6 (violet). At least 4:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 7 (cyan). At least 4:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Categorical colour 8 (olive). At least 3:1 on `pane`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, spent on intent: primary button fill, the selected row in the focused island, checked controls, progress, the active tab rule. Set by the brand.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (at least 4.5:1). Set by the brand.

tokens.name: on-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (metadata, keycaps) inside an `accent`-filled selected row (at least 4.5:1 on `accent`). Set by the brand.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selection in an island without keyboard focus, the active navigation row, toggled icon buttons, tinted chips. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `accent-ink` read on it. Set by the brand.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons: links, the current location, toggled icon buttons, info banner icon. At least 4.5:1 on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `ground` and `accent-soft`. Set by the brand.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, 1px offset, on every focusable control. At least 3:1 on `pane`, `ground` and `raised`. Set by the brand.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand only: the app mark's ground colour. Welcome and About screens, splash, cover. Never a working UI surface. Set by the brand.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments and documentation comments. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords: declaration, control and storage words. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: String and character literals, with their escapes and interpolations. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numeric literals. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Type, class and namespace names. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names, where declared and where called. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and parameters a grammar names as such. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-constant
tokens.usage: Language constants (true, null), named constants and enum values. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-operator
tokens.usage: Operators. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-punctuation
tokens.usage: Delimiters, separators and terminators. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-attribute
tokens.usage: Annotations, attributes and markup attribute names. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: syntax-tag
tokens.usage: Markup tag names. Code text on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `raised`, `pane-hover`, `success-bg` and `danger-bg` (at least 4.5:1).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Cantarell, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.reading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome and empty-state headline only. One per window.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog, sheet and settings page titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The headline of the selected item in a detail or reader island (a commit subject, a mail subject, a process name).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Recover the connection after an early disconnect
styles.usage: Default for rows, fields, menus and running text in the UI.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The current item, unread rows, emphasised row text, island titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented options, chips, tabs, field labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Toolbar button labels, metadata lines, help text, the status bar.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section headers in sidebars, menus and the palette, set in capitals in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, file content, command output, diff lines.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Identifiers a person might paste: hashes, PIDs, message IDs, line numbers. `ink-muted` unless selected.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Thanks for the notes. I moved the review to Thursday.
styles.usage: Long-form content a person reads rather than scans: mail bodies, notes, release notes. The brand may set a serif `reading` family.

styles.name: display-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: screen and empty-state headline.

styles.name: title-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: sheet, dialog and page titles.

styles.name: heading-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: detail headline.

styles.name: body-touch
styles.sample: Pages are saved on this device
styles.usage: Touch density: rows, fields, menus and running text.

styles.name: body-strong-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: current and emphasised rows.

styles.name: label-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: buttons, tabs, chips, field labels.

styles.name: caption-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: metadata and help text.

styles.name: overline-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: section headers in capitals.

styles.name: code-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: code and identifiers.

styles.name: code-sm-touch
styles.usage: Touch density: short identifiers.

styles.name: reading-touch
styles.sample: The derivative measures how the function changes.
styles.usage: Touch density: long-form content.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges, the segmented track inset, gaps inside compound chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in chips and toolbar buttons; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The island gutter: between islands and from the window edge. Row inset from the island edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The working unit: control padding-x, gap between related controls, row padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Island header padding-x, gap between control groups, button padding-x.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Popover, toast and menu padding; detail content inset; touch screen margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, settings row spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog section gaps, sheet padding, welcome gutters.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Empty-state rhythm, touch section gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Touch empty-state rhythm and page top margins.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps, status tiles, inline highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows (the selection is an inset rounded bar, never full-bleed), chips, menu items, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, select, segmented track, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Islands, banners, cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Everything that floats: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs, the palette; the top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges, switches, progress bars, avatars, pill tabs.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Every island. It is the island's edge: islands have no separate border.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs, sheets and the palette.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the select trigger and the selected segment: a 1px lip, never a blur.

tokens.name: size-row-compact
tokens.usage: Row height at compact density.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Row height at regular density (the desktop default): list, navigation and menu rows.

tokens.name: size-row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Row height at comfortable density.

tokens.name: size-row-touch
tokens.usage: Row height at touch density (phones and tablets).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls and selects on desktop.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Controls inside island headers and rows (hover actions, filters).

tokens.name: size-control-touch
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and segmented controls at touch density.

tokens.name: size-target-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target at touch density, even when the visible control is smaller.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: UI icons; 14px inside chips and small controls, 18px in the toolbar, 20px at touch density.

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Unified desktop title bar and toolbar.

tokens.name: size-appbar-touch
tokens.usage: Touch app bar.

tokens.name: size-island-header
tokens.usage: Island header strip.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width (resizable 200–360).

motion.note: Durations in ms. See design/project/guides/40-motion.md. Honour reduce motion through MeridianMotion.

curves.name: standard
curves.usage: Moves and changes that start and end on screen.

curves.name: enter
curves.usage: Arrivals: fast start, long gentle landing.

springs.name: gentle
springs.usage: Drag settle, reorder, travel, toasts arriving.

springs.name: pop
springs.usage: Small rewards: count increase, badge, radio dot, checkbox fill.

scales.name: overlay-enter
scales.usage: Menus, popovers, suggestions and exits start or end here.

scales.name: rise-content
scales.usage: Content swap, banner and empty-state rise in px.

scales.name: shake-field
scales.usage: Field shake amplitude in px (3 cycles over 240 ms).

scales.name: shake-surface
scales.usage: Dialog shake amplitude in px (3 cycles over 280 ms).

scales.name: stagger-max
scales.usage: Items staggered in an entrance; the rest appear with the last.

scales.name: pulse-scale
scales.usage: A live halo grows to this scale while fading.

scales.name: glide-max-rows
scales.usage: Longer selection jumps crossfade instead of gliding.

tokens.name: motion-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill in, and press fills.

tokens.name: motion-hover-out
tokens.usage: Hover fill out: slower, so sweeping the pointer across rows leaves a soft trail.

tokens.name: motion-press
tokens.usage: Press-in: a control scales to press-scale.

tokens.name: motion-quick
tokens.usage: Small flips: icon swap, count roll, check stroke, chevron rotate, colour-only changes.

tokens.name: motion-select
tokens.usage: Selection bar, toggles, tab rule when not springing.

tokens.name: motion-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: overlays, toasts, rows, hover actions.

tokens.name: motion-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, suggestions and tooltips entering: fade in while rising 4px.

tokens.name: motion-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet surface entering; scrim fade.

tokens.name: motion-layout
tokens.usage: Size changes: disclosure, banner, row insert or remove, button width, reveal.

tokens.name: motion-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and side panels sliding in.

tokens.name: motion-emphasized
tokens.usage: Values in live lists and meters moving to a new value.

tokens.name: motion-highlight
tokens.usage: An app's signature moment, e.g. an item travelling to its new home.

tokens.name: motion-celebrate
tokens.usage: A rare success moment; at most one per action the person took.

tokens.name: motion-attention
tokens.usage: A changed item's accent-soft tint fading back to normal.

tokens.name: motion-reduced-fade
tokens.usage: The crossfade that replaces movement under reduce motion (MeridianMotion.fade).

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between successive items in an entrance; at most stagger-max items are staggered.

tokens.name: motion-spinner-delay
tokens.usage: Wait before a spinner or busy state appears, so fast work never flashes.

tokens.name: motion-shake-field
tokens.usage: One field shake (MM-09).

tokens.name: motion-shake-surface
tokens.usage: One dialog shake (MM-47).

tokens.name: motion-nudge
tokens.usage: A toolbar icon's nudge out (MM-07); the return is spring-snappy.

tokens.name: motion-hold
tokens.usage: How long a success check stays (MM-04).

tokens.name: motion-progress-hold
tokens.usage: A progress bar at 100% waits this long before it fades (MM-63).

tokens.name: motion-tooltip-wait
tokens.usage: Delay before a tooltip shows.

tokens.name: motion-tooltip-warm
tokens.usage: Reserved: after a tooltip hides, the next one within this window shows at once.

tokens.name: motion-pulse
tokens.usage: One loop of a live halo.

tokens.name: motion-skeleton-pulse
tokens.usage: One half-cycle of a skeleton's breathing.

tokens.name: motion-march
tokens.usage: One period of a drop zone's marching dashes (MM-77).

tokens.name: motion-spinner
tokens.usage: One spinner turn (2000 with reduce motion).

tokens.name: motion-spinner-reduced
tokens.usage: One spinner turn with reduce motion.

tokens.name: motion-progress
tokens.usage: One sweep of the indeterminate progress bar.

tokens.name: motion-skeleton-delay
tokens.usage: Wait before skeletons appear, so fast loads never flash them.

tokens.name: motion-toast
tokens.usage: How long a toast stays.

tokens.name: motion-toast-action
tokens.usage: How long a toast with an action (Undo) stays.
